title: Why Baldur couldn't feel anything in God of War
subject: baldur
description:
Would you trade every feeling for immortality? 👇

Why the stranger at Kratos's door was cursed by his own mother. Spoilers for God of War (2018).

Fan-made content. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Santa Monica Studio or Sony Interactive Entertainment. Game images © their respective owners.

scenes.text: Baldur hadn't felt a single thing in over a hundred years.
His mother, Freya, had been warned that her son would die a needless death.
So she cast a spell on him. No blade, no fire, no fall could hurt him.
It also took his touch, his taste, even the feeling of cold.
Then Odin sent him to a house in the woods of Midgard, looking for a giant.
He knocked on Kratos's door and said, "Tell me what I want to know."
He threw the first punch, hoping someone was finally strong enough to make him feel pain.
